labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Names a specific docs error: CONTRIBUTING.md links AI_POLICY.md on the master branch, which 404s. The PR question is secondary.

items.body:
The link to `AI_POLICY.md` in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) (line 14) points to the `master` branch, which is the broken link you found. Changing it to `main` is the fix this issue describes.

Pull requests are limited to collaborators. Per [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md), contributors describe the change in an issue first, and a maintainer decides whether a pull request is wanted. Related earlier discussion: #4203.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
